nodes.label: main(args)
nodes.desc: CLI orchestration: parse args, init distributed device, create model/transforms/tokenizer, run epochs and eval.

nodes.label: create_model_and_transforms
nodes.desc: Resolves model config + pretrained tag, instantiates the model, builds train/val preprocessing.

nodes.label: _PRETRAINED registry
nodes.desc: Curated per-model weight configs (URL / HF hub, mean/std, quick_gelu) plus download and caching helpers.

nodes.label: CLIP
nodes.desc: Canonical dual-tower model: visual tower + text tower, learnable logit_scale, encode_image/encode_text.

nodes.label: Vision / Text Transformers
nodes.desc: Native ViT image tower and causal-masked text tower blocks.

nodes.label: TimmModel
nodes.desc: Wraps any timm backbone as a CLIP vision tower.

nodes.label: HFTextEncoder
nodes.desc: Borrows HuggingFace transformer encoders as the text tower with a projection head.

nodes.label: HFTokenizer
nodes.desc: AutoTokenizer bridge plus SimpleTokenizer (original CLIP BPE) and SigLip variants.

nodes.label: ClipLoss
nodes.desc: Symmetric info-NCE over the logit scale; SigLIP, distillation and CoCa variants.

nodes.label: train_one_epoch
nodes.desc: Autocast step loop: prepare batch, forward task, backward, logit-scale clamp, metric logging.

nodes.label: init_distributed_device
nodes.desc: torch.distributed setup from torchrun/SLURM env, backend pick (nccl/gloo/...), local rank.

nodes.label: build_zero_shot_classifier
nodes.desc: Builds class embeddings from prompt templates; powers end-of-epoch zero-shot eval.
